notes.title: Odyssey: Altar of Norax patch 0.11.0!!!
notes.notes:
Happy Spring, Adventurers!

Right in time for the new season, a new patch! Our resident brainiac Bearable has been heard at work making tons of updates, additions and fixes to the game over the passed week. Along with the usual variety of bug fixes and performance updates, there's been some awesome new core features added like dialog boxes, portraits for NPCs and MORE! 

For those that are interested in more detailed patch fixes and daily updates on the game Check out the bottom of this post for our discord link and how you can get in touch with us!

Lets dig into some of the new goodies!


NPCs Portraits and Dialog Boxes!

The world has been a quiet place so far, No Longer!


A new UI element has finished being added, giving NPCs their own Dialog box popup UI and portraits! NPCs now have dialog boxes and various options to click on to progress quests, browse items in a shop, chit chat and hear the gossip around town and more!

[previewyoutube=9enSEBHht3c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Visuals additions and Fixes!

Along with a few bug fixes and visual fixes for some particle effects and lighting, a new visual effect was added that is a real quality of life upgrade for visibility in the cities where there are many large buildings that would cover the player. A transparency was added to ceilings and roof layers so that when players pass under these layers you can see where you are and where the doors of the building you are trying to enter are located. 

[previewyoutube=GLbOR_u--QA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


A new visual animation!

Another small update was the addition of a new door and animation mechanic for caves and in the future various other animated / moveable items. 

[previewyoutube=Fzrvv91bFsU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]






If you're interested in our community and want to keep up to date on the detailed development of Odyssey: Altar of Norax and get a Closed Beta key while available. Come Join our discord!!

notes.title: Odyssey: Altar of Norax Patch 0.10.2
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

This small patch contains a few new features, back end performance and security updates and some new visual features! Lets dive into some of these new goodies! Check out the bottom of this post to get more detailed patch notes and one of the Limited BETA KEYS!!! 

Multiple Character Support and UI 

Rejoice Alt character addicts! Multi Character support has been added!!!

For those adventurers who love having a multitude of different characters, today marks a minor mile stone in implementing multiple characters. This feature will allow players to have multiple characters tied to their steam accounts. This will allow players to have many alternate characters, classes, and builds all attached to 1 account all tied to their steam! 

[previewyoutube=YlhYxUh6rFk;full][/previewyoutube]

Doors have been given a nice facelift!
 
Small visual update for entrances and exits and doors throughout the world. To give doors a little better visibility and a little flair doors now have a subtle highlight and animation around them.

[previewyoutube=HJ56A9plBJE;full][/previewyoutube]

A new visual tooltip! 
The world is vast and sprawling and so are the metropolises, a new tool tip has been added that will feature bubbles above certain doors that correspond to various shops, merchants, places of interest, locked doors and more!
